The word दाश and गोघ्न are irregularly formed and the affix in these denotes the idea of the Dative or Receipient.

Terms: Irregular

The participles दाश्वाम् , साह्वान् , and मीढ्वान् are irregularly formed without reduplication.

Terms: लिट् लकार

A preposition ending in इ or उ lengthens its final before the verb दा when the latter is changed to त।

Terms: संहिता Lengthening

म् is substituted for the द् of इदम् before a विभक्ति affix.

Terms: सर्वनाम इदम्

द् or रु may optionally be substituted for the द् of a root, , before the personal ending सि (स्) when such द् stands at the end of a word.

Terms: स् change
